name: Small Engine & Tractor Service
description: Hour-based oil, air filter, spark plug and grease intervals for tractors, mowers, generators and small engines. Check your owner's manual: these are common starting points.

reminders.title: Engine Oil Change
reminders.notes: Change engine oil (and the filter, if it has one) at 50 hours or yearly, whichever comes first: oil ages even when the engine sits.

reminders.title: Air Filter Clean / Inspect
reminders.notes: More often in dust or dry grass.

reminders.title: Spark Plug Replacement
reminders.notes: Diesels have no spark plug: remove this reminder.

reminders.title: Grease Fittings
reminders.notes: Grease every zerk: front axle, loader pins, mower deck spindles.
